assets.meaning: Only scan encounter tokens changed after automatic startup presence check; source IDs, paths, content revisions, availability and analysis metadata retained.

activeDocument.meaning: Autosave heartbeat updated the wrapper timestamp; document state, revision, saved-file identity and pointer are unchanged.

retainedSessionTakePreviewFiles.onlyChange: Active JSON wrapper updated timestamp; state and revision unchanged.

preferences.explanation: Window geometry persisted at the original initial normal quit, after the pre-quit backup and before the final in-place reopen. Retained the newer persisted geometry. Main.cpp Window destructor owns this write; no old preferences were restored.
